body: Public Safety Committee - City Council Committee
name: Public Safety Committee Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the City Council's
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  THURSDAY, MARCH 21, 2024 – 3:30 p.m.
  .
  .

To provide Public Comments, you may attend in-person at City Hall or submit your written
comments via email to the City Clerk's Office (cityclerk@wlv.org) no later than 11:00 a.m. on the
meeting date. Written comments will be provided to Public Safety Committee Members prior to
the meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-Supplemental-Packets

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to the Committee Members less
 than 72 hours prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal
 business hours and are posted on the City’s Website https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-
 Supplemental-Packets

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a
 central location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your
 notifications.  Sign up using “Notify Me” on the Westlake Village home page or
 https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx
 CALL TO ORDER  3:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmember Pearl, Councilmember McSweeney

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Public Safety Committee on items not on the printed agenda and
within the Council’s/Committee’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three minutes.
Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom
teleconference service options as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a
Speaker Card and submit it City Staff prior to the meeting starting.

BUSINESS:

1.  Public Safety Report – Los Angeles Sheriff Department (LASD) and City staff will
  provide an overview of recent public safety statistics, trends, and strategies.

2.  Los Angeles Sheriff Department Contract Renewal – Discussion on renewal
  process, proposed fees, and services.

3.  Public Safety Officer Position – Discussion on new position, job duties, budget
  and recruitment.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, March 15, 2024 at 2:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  March 15, 2024
